brief: A compact desk unit with a drawer, plus a spike at a corner where three bases meet to hold a small platform.

requirements.requirement: Compact desk unit with a drawer
requirements.evidence: Notch drawer frame hex-drawer-frame-notch-mf placed at -1,1 between bases 0,0,0 and 0,1,0 (ref notch:0#-1,1#notch0). Frame includes drawer per catalog; 3x full bases provide compact desk footprint.

requirements.requirement: Spike at corner where three bases meet to hold small platform
requirements.evidence: Spike at junction 0,0|0,1|1,0 (ref spike:0#0,0|0,1|1,0) changed to variant mount and accessory set to platform-sm successfully; spike enabled only after placing 3 mutually-adjacent bases.

finish.summary: Built 3-base triangular cluster creating a 3-way junction, installed mount spike with platform-sm at that corner, and added notch drawer frame in the adjacent notch gap to provide drawer storage; meshClash clear.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
